title: AUTHORIZE the Chief Executive Officer to award a firm fixed unit rate contract, Contract No. OP1421678370000 to Link-Nilsen Corporation, the lowest…
text:
[Metro Board file 2026-0680, Contract]
[OPERATIONS, SAFETY, AND CUSTOMER EXPERIENCE COMMITTEE MADE THE FOLLOWING RECOMMENDATION (5-0):]
AUTHORIZE the Chief Executive Officer to award a firm fixed unit rate contract, Contract No. OP1421678370000 to Link-Nilsen Corporation, the lowest responsive and responsible bidder to provide Fire-Life Safety systems testing, repair, and certification services for a Not-To-Exceed (NTE) amount of $7,881,404 for the three-year base period, and $3,959,720 for one, two-year option for a total NTE amount of $11,841,124, effective February 1, 2027, subject to the resolution of any properly submitted protest(s), if any.
